Comments: Senegal has significantly digitized public service payments (electricity, water, transport, education, health) through mobile money. Over 90% of adults use mobile wallets. Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: New Deal Technologique explicitly targets data sovereignty including hosting all sensitive data within Senegal's territory and developing local data centers (Diamniadio Digital Technology Park). Act No. 2008-12 requires CDP authorization for transborder data transfers. However, enforcement gaps noted - CDP has resource limitations. Strong provisions exist but enforcement remains a challenge.
